# KMT Global

> KMT Global is a Korean contract supplier of iron castings and machined parts for overseas buyers. One contract covers engineering review, production setup across a Korean manufacturing network, quality control and inspection, and export. KMT Global is an affiliate of KOREA METAL TEC CO., LTD. (케이엠텍㈜), a gray and ductile iron foundry in Goryeong, Korea; each production site is a separate legal entity.

## What KMT Global does
- Contract party for overseas buyers: one contract, one point of contact (Korean, English, Japanese), accountable for quality, delivery and export
- In-house engineering: drawing and castability review (DFM), casting method and pattern design, material and quality engineering, machining and assembly support (process design, tolerance review, post-machining inspection)
- Production setup: assigns each part to the right production route and manages schedule and delivery
- Quality: inspection standards, shipment inspection, traceable inspection documents
- Export: packing, shipping documents, Incoterms agreed per order
- Customer drawings are shared with a production site only within the scope the customer approves in writing (NDA where required)

## Production network
- Furan no-bake casting (small to large, single pieces and low-to-mid volumes) at affiliate KOREA METAL TEC, Goryeong plant: gray iron up to 10 t, ductile iron up to 5 t per piece, about 1,000 t/month; ISO 9001:2015 held by KOREA METAL TEC CO., LTD.
- Automatic molding lines (high-volume small parts: automotive and driveline, agricultural, construction equipment, rail track, engine parts) at partner foundries, including an IATF 16949-certified foundry (certificate held by that foundry). Partner foundry names are not disclosed.
- Machining by external machining partners, with process design and inspection by KMT Global
- Materials: gray iron (KS GC / JIS FC) and ductile iron (KS GCD / JIS FCD); equivalents to ASTM / EN are approximate and confirmed per drawing

## Typical parts
Machine-tool beds, columns, saddles and tables; pump casings; gear cases; bases and counterweights; differential and transfer cases; axle cases; wheel hubs; rail base and turnout plates; rocker-arm supports.

## How to work with us
RFQ → NDA (if needed) → engineering review and route selection → quotation → patterns and tooling → first article (PPAP where required) → production → shipment inspection → export. Lead times and prices are quoted per part after drawing review.
